actions.rule: Resolve an already-authorized semantic message state after disclosure reduction.
Inspect the selected safe message object and its provenance without hidden-state expansion.
Preview localized visual copy with allowlisted interpolation.
Preview equivalent screen-reader/nonvisual copy.
List only affordance classes already authorized for the selected state and subject.
Inspect the minimum-safe support-reference policy.
Preview allowlisted/redacted diagnostics; no raw logs or secrets.
Present the upstream retryable nonmutating read operation.
Present transport reconnection; never imply mutation success.
Present authorized status lookup for status-unknown.
Present a projection refresh after an accepted durable Event.
Present upstream current-version inspection for stale state.
Present upstream conflict review without resolving it in copy.
Observe an already-visible approval state.
Present retry only when operation_id/status/idempotency semantics prove it safe.
Edit only an already-visible editable field; no authoritative mutation is created here.
Open F025-authorized help without expanding visibility.
Submit only F025 minimum fields after consent/redaction and upstream operation authorization.
Dismiss or return without changing authoritative state.
Owner/admin/service inspection of unresolved source gaps; ordinary users receive safe-unavailable fallback.

rules: PPIA-14 presents an operation; it never creates mutation authority.
status-unknown must resolve through status lookup before any retry unless the upstream contract independently proves idempotent retry safety.
issue reporting follows F025 consent, redaction, minimum-field and submission rules.
offline/local state never becomes authoritative mutation because copy offers an action.
